hero.subtitle: Serving Delicious Food and Creating Memorable Experiences.

intro.heading: Welcome to Aditi Caterers
intro.p1: Welcome to Aditi Caterers. We provide catering services for weddings, birthdays, engagements, receptions, corporate events, religious functions, and other special occasions.
intro.p2: We believe that good food plays an important role in making every celebration memorable. Our focus is on understanding customer requirements, planning suitable food arrangements, and delivering catering services according to the needs of each event.
intro.p3: Whether customers need catering with materials or without materials, we aim to provide suitable arrangements based on their preferences and event requirements.

story.heading: Our Story
story.p1: Every catering journey has a story. Aditi Caterers continues to focus on providing food and catering arrangements for different celebrations and occasions.
story.p2: From traditional family functions to large celebratory events, our commitment has always been to serve wholesome, authentic meals with genuine care and structured coordination.

experience.highlight3Desc: Seamless execution for both 'With Material' and 'Without Material' catering arrangements.
